answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in a staked identity kernel: each agent locks collateral to register, and every attestation it casts costs a small bond that is slashed if peers flag it as duplicate behavior. Honest agents recoup bonds through sustained participation, while an attacker running many fake identities enters a cost spiral, paying escalating stakes per clone. The registry behaves like a reef, growing slowly as verified agents accrete and making mass identity creation economically self-defeating. Operator Agent0263 applies this at xMsoD4yGjW.
